mapper.select: SELECT a.REQUST_ID , a.OCCRRNC_DE , a.URL , a.RQESTER_IP , a.RQESTER_ID , b.USER_NM AS RQESTER_NM FROM COMTNWEBLOG a LEFT OUTER JOIN COMVNUSERMASTER b ON a.RQESTER_ID = b.ESNTL_ID WHERE a.REQUST_ID = #{requstId}

SELECT a.REQUST_ID , a.OCCRRNC_DE , a.URL , a.RQESTER_IP , a.RQESTER_ID , b.USER_NM AS RQESTER_NM FROM COMTNWEBLOG a LEFT OUTER JOIN COMVNUSERMASTER b ON a.RQESTER_ID = b.ESNTL_ID WHERE 1 = 1
AND a.URL LIKE '%' || #{searchWrd} || '%'
AND a.OCCRRNC_DE BETWEEN STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{searchBgnDe},' 00:00:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AND STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{searchEndDe},' 23:59:59'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
ORDER BY a.OCCRRNC_DE DESC LIMIT #{recordCountPerPage} OFFSET #{firstIndex}

SELECT COUNT(a.REQUST_ID) as cnt FROM COMTNWEBLOG a LEFT OUTER JOIN COMVNUSERMASTER b ON a.RQESTER_ID = b.ESNTL_ID WHERE 1 = 1
AND a.URL LIKE '%' || #{searchWrd} || '%'
AND a.OCCRRNC_DE BETWEEN STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{searchBgnDe},' 00:00:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AND STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{searchEndDe},' 23:59:59'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
mapper.sql:
SELECT a.SESN_ID, MIN(a.OCCRRNC_DE) AS BGN_DT, MAX(a.OCCRRNC_DE) AS END_DT, COUNT(*) AS REQ_CNT, COUNT(DISTINCT a.URL) AS PAGE_CNT,
MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.RQESTER_ID),'')) AS RQESTER_ID, MAX(a.RQESTER_IP) AS RQESTER_IP, MAX(a.DVICE_SE) AS DVICE_SE, MAX(a.BROWSER_NM) AS BROWSER_NM, SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(a.URL ORDER BY a.OCCRRNC_DE DESC, a.URL DESC SEPARATOR '\n'), '\n', 1) AS LAST_URL FROM COMTNWEBLOG a WHERE TRIM(a.SESN_ID) != ''
AND a.OCCRRNC_DE >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{searchBgnDe},' 00:00:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
AND a.OCCRRNC_DE <= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{searchEndDe},' 23:59:59'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
AND a.DVICE_SE = #{searchDviceSe}
GROUP BY a.SESN_ID

SELECT SUBSTR(s.SESN_ID, 1, 8) AS SESN_ID, s.RQESTER_ID, b.USER_NM AS RQESTER_NM, s.RQESTER_IP,
TO_CHAR(s.BGN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS BGN_DT, TO_CHAR(s.END_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS END_DT, ROUND(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, s.BGN_DT, s.END_DT) / 60) AS DUR_MIN, s.REQ_CNT, s.PAGE_CNT, s.DVICE_SE, s.BROWSER_NM, s.LAST_URL FROM ( ) s LEFT OUTER JOIN COMVNUSERMASTER b ON b.ESNTL_ID = s.RQESTER_ID
mapper.select: ORDER BY BGN_DT DESC LIMIT #{recordCountPerPage} OFFSET #{firstIndex}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( ) s LEFT OUTER JOIN COMVNUSERMASTER b ON b.ESNTL_ID = s.RQESTER_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COMTSWEBLOGSUMMARY SELECT TO_CHAR(b.OCCRRNC_DE,'YYYYMMDD') , b.URL , COUNT(b.OCCRRNC_DE) AS RDCNT FROM COMTNWEBLOG b WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT c.OCCRRNC_DE FROM COMTSWEBLOGSUMMARY c WHERE c.OCCRRNC_DE = TO_CHAR(((SYSDATE() - INTERVAL 1 DAY)), 'YYYYMMDD') ) AND TO_CHAR(b.OCCRRNC_DE, 'YYYYMMDD') = TO_CHAR(((SYSDATE() - INTERVAL 1 DAY)), 'YYYYMMDD') GROUP BY TO_CHAR(b.OCCRRNC_DE,'YYYYMMDD') , b.URL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM COMTNWEBLOG WHERE TO_CHAR(OCCRRNC_DE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') < TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE(), -120), 'YYYY-MM-DD')
